summary: The proposed patch introduces a new check for forbidden characters in URLs, which may cause behavioral regressions and does not address the root cause of the issue.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new check for forbidden characters in URLs, which may break existing behavior where these characters were previously allowed.
The patch is special-cased to the failing test and does not address the root cause of the issue, which is the change in URL splitting behavior due to the bpo-43882 fix.
